label: pattern self-holding test
criterion: PASS iff in >= 7 of 8 test seeds (1..8) BOTH: (P1) cell fidelity half-life >= 3x control half-life (cell censored value counts as a lower bound) AND (P2) canonical Psi (Omega=0.5 app drive) > 0 for >= 500 consecutive ticks during CUT in the cell arm WHILE the pattern is held (smoothed fidelity >= half-level), so a collapsed/synchronised ring cannot satisfy P2. Anything else = FAIL. Recovery, R, harness-Omega Psi are report-only.
dev_note: Parameters were chosen on dev seeds 1001-1003 only (dev result 2/3 pass). Test seeds 1-8 had never been run when this file was written.

measures.fidelity: centred complex correlation of e^{iθ} with e^{iP}, smoothed over 50 ticks
measures.halfLife: ticks after CUT until smoothed F <= floor + 0.5(F_cut - floor), floor=1/sqrt(N); measured until the first kick (1500 ticks), censored at 1500
measures.psi: canon Ψ=χₙΩ−Δ, 64-tick window, every 50 ticks, Ω=0.5
measures.recovery: smoothed F 400 ticks after each kick / F just before (report-only)
